text.card: A red giant 4,522 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.00 solar masses and 7.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,817 K at its surface.
